uploads.description:
China is full of mysteries. Hundreds of pyramids if not thousands. Mysterious megalithic tunnels. Thousands of rock cut grottoes and too many giant Buddhas that is impossibly human work of art. We all give credit to those who left behind some inscription. However, the tool marks tell a different story.

This video is a compilation of materials that form my own thoughts and opinions – Bernie Ong

Music : Icelandic Arpeggios - DivKid
